Source code: https://github.com/sumatrapdfreader/sumatrapdf

MyLab AutoPrint bundles the unmodified official portable binary and calls it as
a separate program (command line: -print-to / -print-settings / -silent) to print
PDF files. It is not linked into MyLab AutoPrint.
